# Development/test-only dependencies. Runtime deps live in requirements.txt.
# Install with:  pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
#
# Dual-runtime pins (CI matrix: 3.9 + 3.14), selected by python_version
# marker. pytest 9 (>=9.0.3 fixes PYSEC-2026-1845) and pyflakes 4.x require
# >=3.10; the 3.9 branch keeps the last supported versions (accepted risk,
# see requirements.txt header / security tracker item #9).
#
# httpx/httpx2 back starlette's TestClient (used by the API-level tests).
# The 3.9 runtime's older starlette imports plain httpx; starlette 1.6+
# imports httpx2 and only falls back to httpx with a
# StarletteDeprecationWarning, so the 3.10+ branch pins httpx2 explicitly
# (it was never pinned — CI's 3.14 leg always warned at
# tests/test_api_analyze_flow.py:31).
# pyflakes backs scripts/check_undefined_names.sh (the CI import lint).
#
# Hash-locked like requirements.txt (full closure, both marker branches) —
# regenerate with scripts/pin_requirements.py after changing a pin.
